title: ROS 1 frontier exploration to ROS 2 Jazzy with Nav2 simulation

checks.title: Preserve pinned source algorithms and approved grid-boundary corrections
Real Gazebo lidar, map, transform, frontier publication and completed Nav2 goal

limitations: Source baseline executes pinned ROS1 algorithms with Python2 division compatibility; no ROS1 simulator execution
One differential-drive robot in the official Nav2 Gazebo sandbox; no physical hardware verification
Existing Nav2, SLAM and Gazebo infrastructure is reused and is not authored by Goose
Supported source revision and fixture only; new ROS projects need their own executable acceptance contract
